column1: # tgid-tags.tsv — Talkgroup ID to name mapping
# Tag       Human-readable name (shown in web UI and Icecast metadata)
# Priority  Optional. Integer 1–9. Lower number = higher priority (preempts lower-priority calls).
#           Default is 3 if omitted. Use priority 1 for critical channels.
# Lines starting with # are comments and are ignored.
# The file must be UTF-8 (with or without BOM).
# Colors are NOT set here — they are set in cfg.json under terminal.smart_colors
# using keyword matching on the Tag text.
# Example entries — replace with your actual system's talkgroup IDs and names:
